title: This 20yr old girl is a marketing genius…
description:
Start building & deploying paywalls in 10 minutes flat: https://superwall.com/

Private dinners for $100k/mo app founders: https://75v4gfh4e3l.typeform.com/to/CgZbJWb6

Spy on outlier TikToks that went viral promoting apps: https://spytok.com/

Join a community of world class consumer app founders and growth hackers: https://joinconsumerclub.com/

Hosted & produced by Joseph Choi: https://twitter.com/JosephKChoi

I show how this 20yr old girl is a marketing genius by connecting creativity with app development and mobile app development. I explain how I used my app development roadmap and combined it with smart business ideas to build apps that stand out. My journey started with app development for beginners, learning coding, programming, and eventually becoming a software developer.

I reveal the strategies that helped me understand software development and even move into full stack development while keeping a sharp focus on the right business model. You’ll see how I figured out how to develop an app, how to create an app, and how to make an app that people actually want to use.

This video also explores new business ideas, the best business ideas, and creative app ideas that turned my work into a real business. If you’ve ever wondered how to make an app while building something profitable, you’ll see how I did it step by step and why people call me a marketing genius at just 20 years old.
